Had the privilege of a meaningful conversation with Mr. Sanjay Dutt, MD & CEO – Tata Realty & Infrastructure Ltd @sanjayduttlimitfree , during the Realty+ India Brand Leadership Conclave 2026, @rp_realty

Our discussion touched upon the increasing complexity of land acquisition in Mumbai and how Tata Realty balances patience with precision while entering competitive micro-markets, clearly choosing trust and long-term value over haste.

We also spoke about Tata Realty’s approach to steady expansion, with a focused investment of ~₹2,000 crore each into residential and commercial projects over the next two years, reinforcing their belief in disciplined, sustainable growth.

Another insightful aspect was how leadership across diverse Tata businesses remains aligned, ensuring clarity of focus without dilution, even while operating across multiple sectors.

Grateful for the patience, humility, and openness with which Mr. Sanjay Dutt shared his perspectives. Conversations like these are quiet reminders of what principled leadership truly looks like.

A note of appreciation to Realty+ India Brand Leadership Conclave for curating such a well-thought-out and insightful platform. An event that truly added value beyond the stage.

Few people understand this better than Dr. Kiran Bedi.

Whether in policing, public administration, or leadership, she has spent decades making high-stakes decisions where waiting for complete information was not always an option and where every decision invited scrutiny.

That made me wonder:

When uncertainty is unavoidable and public opinion is loud, how do you know whether your hesitation is coming from a genuine concern or from a fear created by your own mind?

Because in business, entrepreneurship, and life, many opportunities are lost not due to a lack of ability or information, but because fear disguises itself as caution.

Learning to separate facts from fear may be one of the most important leadership skills we can develop.

A privilege to ask this question and hear her perspective.

insightful interaction with Dr. Niranjan Hiranandani at the @cnbctv18india @wework.in event today.

Got opportunity to talk about the future of affordable housing, the evolution of integrated townships, and what could become Mumbai’s next transformational urban cluster,
